sentences.en: The economic development of Algeria will be an arduous ascent.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚的经济发展将是一条艰难的上升之路。

sentences.en: The Alpinists carried out the ascent, but they did not return safely.
sentences.zh: 登山者们完成了攀登，但没有安全返回。

sentences.en: They made first ascent of Mount Everest.
sentences.zh: 他们首次登顶了珠穆朗玛峰。

senses.zh: 垂直上升；上坡路；攀登；（地位、职务的）提升，（水平的）提高；（某些宗教中的）升天
